zh.topic_title: Ruth Wang, Chinese lawyer for underground church, flees to Taiwan – rights group

en.topic_title: Ruth Wang, Chinese lawyer for underground church, flees to Taiwan – rights group
en.topic_summary:
Taiwan said Friday it has provided “temporary accommodation” to a Chinese citizen, after a rights group reported that a lawyer representing detained leaders of an underground church in Beijing had fled to the island.



Ruth Wang. Photo: Ruth Wang.



Taiwan’s top China policy body did not identify the person, but ChinaAid said Ruth Wang, a partner at Vdoor Law Firm in Beijing, had arrived in Taiwan on Wednesday “seeking protection from Taiwanese authorities”.
